report.explanation: Current telemetry shows order service retaining ~300MB after GC with 7 WARN retained_heap_after_gc logs, but gateway/order/inventory/payment error rates and p95 latency are all healthy (0.0012, 72ms), and gateway logs show successful 200s. A single snapshot plus short WARN count is insufficient to establish a memory leak or link it to checkout degradation. No deployment facts or retention trend exist. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service memory-retention time series across multiple windows to establish a sustained growth trend rather than a single snapshot
Baseline/expected memory_retained_bytes for order service to judge whether 300MB is anomalous
Evidence linking order memory retention to gateway checkout errors or latency (causal path)
Confirmation of whether the gateway trace ERROR at 913ms is representative or an isolated sample
